approval_note: Set e.g. SDS_OWNER_APPROVAL_DAEDALUS=yes only by the owner, per platform, to authorize live (paid / money-moving) use after a key is present. Approval alone never substitutes for a missing key.
cost_policy_note: Owner direction 2026-11-13: always use the free resources available first. Free/offline backends (local packages, system TTS, SQLite, Oracle Always Free) are checked and auto-connected before any paid provider. A paid provider is never called without its key, and no live paid call is made by the health check at all.

status_meanings.BROKEN: Local code for this platform fails to compile or import for a reason other than a missing optional provider package/key.
status_meanings.LINKED: A real local check passed (module compiles and imports, and a functional probe succeeded). For keyed providers LINKED additionally means the key and model/secret are present and local wiring builds; live account validity is NOT verified because the health check never makes a live paid call.
status_meanings.MISSING_APPROVAL: Key/secret is present, but a live action needs explicit owner approval and none is recorded.
status_meanings.MISSING_KEY: A required API key, secret, model id, or provider package is absent. The exact missing item is named in the status record.
status_meanings.NOT_IMPLEMENTED: The local module, file, or capability for this platform is absent or is a stub/fake only; no real backend is installed.
